asks.title: Check headless authorization before starting an export
asks.requested_behavior: Provide a non-interactive authorization preflight and document the required human approval.
asks.how_observed: The command requested browser approval after the agent had started the task.
asks.consequence: The unattended task stopped without an output file.
asks.priority_rationale: Expose the prerequisite early so teams can prepare an authorized run.
asks.verification: In headless mode, preflight reports the missing approval before an export begins.

measured.basis: sum over referenced events; tokens attributed per whole assistant message (two asks citing events from the same message both carry its tokens); span = first referenced event start to last referenced event end
